messages:
sasha: starting bring-up for halcyon9b (open checkpoint). hitting two things: int4 runner crashes on longctx (>=1024) and summaries score worse vs gemma-7b on our convo-summarize eval. sharing quick logs and guesses.
kevin: can you paste the stack / tokenizer head/tail? crash trace?
sasha: stack: 
```
RuntimeError: KV cache write out-of-bounds in layer 5
  at redwood/runtime/kvcache.cpp:342
  at redwood/infer/runner.py:128
```
Also tokenizer: first/last tokens look weird (eos at idx 1, pad at 0). snippet: `vocab[:6] = ["","</s>"," the"," of"," and"," to"]`
maria: eos at idx 1 is fine for some exports, but int4 packing+kv offsets often assume eos at 0 or high sentinel. could be token-id->kvslot mapping bug. also halcyon uses head_dim=64 per-head (not 32) — rotary sin/cos layout may be interleaved differently.
aj: quick repro: small script to compare rotary encodings between halcyon and gemma on same token ids: `python -c "from models import load; print(compare_rope(a,b,ids))"` — do we have a deterministic failing prompt?
sasha: yes, short prompt "Summarize:
Alice buys a coffee." length 12 triggers cache offset after a few tokens. eval-bot: automated eval on convo-summarize-small: baseline gemma-7b rougeL=0.42, halcyon9b fp16=0.40, halcyon9b int4=0.34 (stddev n=6), hallucination_rate +7%.
maria: fractional rotary scaling could cause attention phase mismatch when head_dim changed. if our kernel assumes contiguous cos/sin layout for head_dim 32 and halcyon packs 64 differently, kvcache indexing will be off by factor 2 — leads to OOB and semantic drift.
kevin: hypothesis: tokenizer id mapping + head_dim/layout mismatch combine: token ids map to wrong cache slots, earlier tokens override later ones. both crash and quality drop explainable.
sasha: quick test I ran: remap eos->highest_idx at runtime before kvcache write and crash goes away (no OOB). quality still off.
aj: can we run a toy to compare rotary angle matrix between frameworks? paste minimal snippet: 
```
# compare rope layout
a = load_rope(halcyon, seq=128)
b = load_rope(gemma, seq=128)
assert a.shape == b.shape
print((a - b).mean())
```
maria: also check embedding proj order: halcyon checkpoint export used `embed_proj: [out_dim, in_dim]` reversed historically. that can shift token embeddings slightly and hurt summaries. do a roundtrip token->embed->decode similarity check.
eval-bot: added eval jobs: token-roundtrip-similarity, rope-delta, kvcache-oob-smoke. queued (job ids: 48321,48322,48323).
infra-bot: rolled a runtime patch to log kvcache index accesses for int4 runner (deployed to staging). expect more logs in ~10m.
sasha: plan: 1) reproduce minimal failing case and attach numeric diffs (rope + embed) 2) try temporary token-id remap (eos->max) + head_dim-aware rope loader 3) re-run int4 quantization with explicit per-head layout flag 4) run eval-bot suite and compare against gemma baseline. doing 1 now, will post diffs.
kevin: if rope mismatch is confirmed, we should add a small compatibility shim in model-onboarder that inspects config: head_dim and rope_layout and auto-selects loader. also add a tokenizer sanity check for BOS/EOS/pad positions.
maria: agree. I'll draft PR for shim + tokenizer assertions. keep int4 experiments gated behind shim until we ensure kvcache mapping correct.
sasha: update: quick numeric check shows mean abs diff in rope matrices between halcyon and gemma of ~1.2e-3 after scaling mismatch — consistent with different fractional scaling. attaching numbers in thread.
aj: I can try a quick quant run with a per-head transpose flag (int4) tonight. tagging if I see improvements.
eval-bot: job 48322 (rope-delta) finished: max delta 0.012, mean 0.0011. job 48323 (kvcache-oob-smoke) failed on unpatched runtime.
infra-bot: staging logs are streaming, `kvcache_oob_count=14` in the last 5m.
sasha: thanks — okay go ahead with shim PR + tokenizer check. schedule a blocked-for-release label on halcyon9b onboarding until we pass roundtrip+rope checks and int4 smoke.
kevin: noted. I'll add a small integration test to the model-onboard CI.
maria: will open PR with tests and compatibility table entries: halcyon9b -> head_dim=64, rope_layout=interleaved, eos_index=1.
sasha: perfect. will link PRs here when created. good sync. :thumbsup:
